# The one third-party package a workflow installs, pinned by hash as well as by
# version. A version alone names what to fetch; the hash is what makes the fetch
# verifiable, so an artefact replaced under the same version is refused rather
# than run. Installed with --require-hashes, which refuses anything unlisted.
#
# Every cp312 wheel and the source archive, because the workflow pins Python 3.12
# and pip chooses among them by platform. Regenerate when the version moves.
pyyaml==6.0.2 \
    --hash=sha256:c70c95198c015b85feafc136515252a261a84561b7b1d51e3384e0655ddf25ab \
